description: 24-month causal anomaly-window recurrence graph. K, Y and R_C share one graph geometry; forecast adapts between climatological mean reversion and anomaly persistence.

empirical_units.anomaly: degrees Celsius relative to development climatology

invariant_parameters.adaptive_family: two coefficients: intercept + standardized feature slope
invariant_parameters.climatology_rule: month-of-year means estimated from development data only
invariant_parameters.matched_null: same coefficient count and same forecast endpoints

measurement_mapping.K: graph-aligned formation operator with one resource-supported negative mode
measurement_mapping.R_C: same graph eigenbasis with persistent low modes and contractive complement
measurement_mapping.Y: PSD squared recurrence-graph geometry plus scalar stress

name: ENSO Pacific SST BFG Carrier
